subject: Re: Kickoff: Brush - decision: indoor-first demo, exposure work continues
body:
Decision, so we stop burning cycles on this:

The Jul 24 LRB demo is scoped to indoor scenes plus the on-device Android training story - 11 minutes to train a scene on a phone is the demo, honestly; nobody in the room will ask about outdoor PSNR. Nadia, adding us to the LRB agenda for Jul 24 on that basis.

BUT we don't drop the outdoor gap: Rafael and Hyun start the exposure-compensation work now, targeting end of window (Aug 3). If it lands early and the harness shows we've closed to within ~0.8 dB on outdoor, we add one outdoor scene to the demo as an upside surprise. Bilal, please add the two outdoor scenes to the nightly harness dashboard so we can watch the gap close.

Also locking this into the Q3 OKR narrative before the Jun 26 lock: "portable splatting demo through LRB" is the committed item; outdoor parity is stretch.

Lucia
